concepts.text: The post-alpha.1 first-parent history clusters into renderer consolidation, native platforms, native Windows, XNA member closure, content pipeline/CNB/XNB, compiled effects, the C ABI and bindings, Diagnostics/Inspector, the engine layer, sample compatibility and verification cleanup.
The renderer architecture is 25 public identities over 21 families with a generated registry and per-family descriptors.
Graphics parity is evidence-qualified per route: the EasyGL, Vulkan, WebGPU, SDL GPU, Direct3D, Metal, CPU and 2D routes each have their own contracts and suites.

CNA_PLATFORM is an independent axis with direct X11 (Xlib/XKB/XInput/RandR), Wayland (xdg-shell, text-input, data-device) and Win32 (HWND, raw input, DPI) implementations that use no SDL, validated by Xvfb, Weston/Mutter and MinGW/Wine/MSVC harnesses.
The audio axis adds a native ALSA implementation with its own mixer beside SDL3, SDL2 and NULL.
The XNA runtime API is represented as 331/331 types and 3,627/3,627 members by a generated census, which is representation coverage only, not behaviour.

target.evidence: tools/audit_xna_runtime_surface.py and its generated report at 009d40f5

concepts.text: The Content Pipeline is a physical build-time module with a CLI (cna-content), an MSBuild task, importers, processors, writers, a build graph and a cache.
CNB is CNA's versioned chunk container with typed schemas and optional Zstd compression, produced by the build-time pipeline.
XNB support covers read and write, the shared-resource object graph, LZX/LZ4 compression, external references and pipeline production.
Compiled effects are re-audited per format (Effect bytecode, XNB Effect, FNA .fxb) and per renderer route.

target.evidence: Effect reader and renderer compiled-effect paths at 009d40f5

concepts.text: The experimental C ABI is 0.29.0 with a generated coverage inventory of 9,355 symbols (8,363 implemented, 15 partial, 468 planned, 509 not applicable).

target.evidence: modules/c-api/include/CNA/C/abi.h and the generated coverage mapping at 009d40f5

concepts.text: Diagnostics is a renderer-independent OFF/STATS/FULL module and Inspector an explicit opt-in agent with an authenticated bridge and browser UI.
The CNAEXT engine layer (graphics-ext) grew PBR, HDR, shadows, post-processing, compute and scene helpers behind CNA_CNAEXT.
Media and video became an optional FFmpeg route selected by CNA_ENABLE_VIDEO, alongside changed audio capture, device and network/service implementations.

target.evidence: modules/video-ffmpeg and CMake options at 009d40f5; docs/video-playback.html (checked)
